outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured confocal micrograph images (photoactivation time-lapse frames), not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel B shows line/scatter plots of normalized intensity over time (main curves are per-experiment time-course data points with fitted diffusion model lines; insets show averaged time-course responses with error bars across time points). These are line/time-course plots, which are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points since overlaying raw points would clutter such time-series representations, and the main plots already display the raw measured points themselves.
